The PR carries a bounded stderr tail across Gmail watcher chunks so split address-in-use errors stop respawns, with two regression tests.

PR surface: Source +6, Tests +78. Total +84 across 2 files.

target.title: fix(gmail): preserve bind errors across watcher output chunks
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where the Gmail watcher enters an endless 5-second respawn loop when its gog serve process fails with an "address already in use" error and the error message happens to be split across stderr pipe chunks. Instead of recognizing the bind failure and stopping restarts, the watcher respawns indefinitely.

## Why This Change Was Made

The stderr `data` handler classified each chunk independently against the address-in-use regex, so a short marker like `address already in use` split across two chunks (e.g. `"address alre"` + `"ady in use"`) was never detected. The fix carries a bounded 512-byte stderr tail across chunks so the classification sees the complete marker before the exit handler decides whether to stop or to schedule a respawn.

## User Impact

Operators with an already-running Gmail watcher (or a stale port binding) no longer experience an infinite 5-second respawn loop when starting a second watcher. The watcher correctly stops restarts and logs a clear diagnostic.

## Evidence

**Before (RED):** Without the fix, a split `address already in use` marker produced a second spawn after 5 s — the watcher entered the restart loop.

```
$ pnpm test src/hooks/gmail-watcher.test.ts -- --run -t "stops restarts when address-in-use marker is split"
 FAIL  startGmailWatcher > stops restarts when address-in-use marker is split across stderr chunks
AssertionError: expected [ …(2) ] to have a length of 1 but got 2
→ 2 children spawned (respawn happened when it should not)
```

**Premise:** `isAddressInUseError` in `src/hooks/gmail-watcher-errors.ts:5` correctly matches `/address already in use|EADDRINUSE/i`, but the `data` handler in `spawnGogServe` supplied individual chunk fragments without line-framing or a carried tail. The exit handler at line 118 checks the boolean `addressInUse` — when it stays false the handler schedules a 5 s respawn.

**After (GREEN):** With the bounded tail, the split marker is detected and restarts stop.

```
$ pnpm test src/hooks/gmail-watcher.test.ts -- --run
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  11 passed (11)
```

**Negative control:** A non-bind error split across chunks still schedules exactly one respawn (confirming the fix does not suppress legitimate restarts). A complete bind marker is also still detected through the existing path.

**Focused tests:** Two new tests in `src/hooks/gmail-watcher.test.ts` — split bind-marker detection and negative control. All 11 pass (9 existing + 2 new).

**Diff stats:** 10 prod LOC, 78 test LOC. `git diff --check` clean. Oxlint clean.

**Unverified:** Real gog child-process pipe with a live port conflict. The production stderr pipe delivers chunks at OS buffer boundaries, and the test harness reproduces this with sequential EventEmitter emits. A real gog serve on an occupied port typically emits one complete line, but the fix is correct for the split case regardless of whether it occurs in practice.

*AI-assisted*
